card.name: Spinal hematoma paralysis warning wording
card.fires_on: Words inside the anticoagulant spinal hematoma warning, mainly "-term" in "long-term or permanent paralysis" and "permanent" after "or". It also fires on a few words in similar serious-outcome lists.

modes.label: Long-term or permanent paralysis
modes.description: The "-term" after "long" or "permanent" in the neuraxial anesthesia hematoma warning.
modes.example: These hematomas may result in long<<-term>> or permanent paralysis.

modes.label: Other warning-text words
modes.description: Scattered words in contraindication or complication sentences, such as a space before a number of weeks or "required" after constipation.
modes.example: Major surgery within the preceding<< >>6 weeks

card.plain: It marks the stock warning phrase that spinal bleeding can cause long-term or permanent paralysis in patients on blood thinners.
